newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-Mcgee adds 68 mln BOE to reserves.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-Mcgee adds 68 mln BOE to reserves.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Corp said Tuesday it had added proved oil and natural gas reserves of 68 million barrels of oil equivalent (BOE) in 1996, equivalent to 160 percent of last year's production of 42 million BOE.
The company said it marks the eighth time in the last nine years that reserve additions have exceeded production.
The reserve additions and production were the second-highest in its history, said the company.

The single largest 1996 reserve addition, said the company, was the Janice field in the United Kingdom sector of the North Sea, where Kerr-McGee is the operator and holds a 50.9 percent working interest.
Another notable reserve addition in 1996, said the company, was the North Geragai field on the Jabung Block in Indonesia, where Kerr-McGee has a 30 percent interest.

Kerr-McGee oil and gas reserves at the end of the year totaled 256 million BOE. Including Kerr-McGee's 31 percent interest in Devon Energy Corp's reserves, total reserves at the end of 1996 were 312 million BOE.
The company also said it reduced its finding cost to $4.21 per BOE in 1996 and has a goal of keeping its finding costs at or near a level of $4.50 per BOE.
